page.notes: Year 1638 is printed in the head between the running title and the page number; it is not part of the running head. A small dot stands in the right margin beside "quod aliis negatum"; no note text is attached, so it is not transcribed. The Greek phrase is doubtful in its first word and in the middle of the phrase; the accent and the sign § are uncertain. "suppositititium" is copied as it appears on the scan. "Iunio" is written "Junio" by the consonant-j rule. The bottom of the page ends with "Chal-", a word broken across the page; no catchword is printed.
